_meta.purpose: Durable extracted evidence map for VOYAGE-001A; not a public runtime contract.

claims.claim: Active voyaging lasts about five days.
A one-day collection window follows active voyaging; dispatch stops, opening/merging remains available, and unopened treasures auto-open at the end.
A normal voyage lasts eight hours.
Each Compass reduces voyage time by exactly one hour.
Complete All can consume enough Compasses to finish ongoing voyages in a burst.
Team 3 is described as a 10,000 Gem unlock, with later text advising players to check the exact in-game price.
Team 4 is described as a paid $5/Starter Backpack unlock for the current event.
Three Common Tidal Treasures merge into one Premium Tidal Treasure.
Three Premium treasures produce a 75% Exquisite / 25% Majestic probability roll.
Three Premium treasures can be directed by the player to Exquisite or Majestic.
Voyage milestones are 1, 5, 20, 60, 120, 200 and 350 with the published rewards in event.json.
Sails Aloft/Team 4 pack Compass counts are 100, 160, 300, 600 and 60 respectively.
